## What this changes

One sentence.

## What it teaches

This repository is read far more often than it is run. If the change does not
make some part of MCP clearer, say why it is still worth having.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes (Go tests + C++ tests)
- [ ] `make vet` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test that fails without the change
- [ ] No new dependencies (Go standard library and POSIX only)
- [ ] Comments explain *why*, not *what*

## Spec reference

If this touches the protocol, link the section of the MCP specification.
